mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing temperatures of 67 degrees under mainly clear skies at Verona Community Park, with the moon currently in its third quarter phase.

The City of Verona continues to maintain infrastructure with ongoing engineering reports through AECOM. Additionally, the Senior Center is offering free tri-shaw bike rides, allowing residents to enjoy the Military Ridge State Trail with a trained pilot.
There is plenty to do in Verona. We have Live Music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee happening today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.

Regarding local public safety, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that led to an arrest for an O W I, as well as citations for a prohibited alcohol concentration and suspended registration.
Today's flavor of the day is Really Reese's. Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10 AM today for you to enjoy a treat.
